AboutPage.metaDescription: A decade of building what cannot fail. PT. SUME (Solusi Utama Mekanikal Elektrikal) delivers integrated power, cooling, monitoring, and security systems for facilities that operate around the clock.
AboutPage.headerTitle: A Decade of Building What Cannot Fail.
AboutPage.headerDescription: The systems behind a building — its power, its cooling, its controls — deserve the same rigor as the structure itself.
AboutPage.whoWeAreHeading: Engineering the infrastructure that cannot afford to fail.
AboutPage.whoWeAreBody: PT. SUME (Solusi Utama Mekanikal Elektrikal) began as a mechanical and electrical contractor with a simple conviction: that the systems behind a building — its power, its cooling, its controls — deserve the same rigor as the structure itself. Over [years] years, that conviction has grown into a comprehensive M&E capability. What started with commercial building installations has expanded into critical infrastructure — where SUME now delivers integrated power, cooling, monitoring, and security systems for facilities that operate around the clock. Today, SUME serves clients across Indonesia and the region, supported by offices in Singapore and Myanmar, and an ecosystem of specialized capabilities spanning standby power, solar energy, precision cooling, and intelligent monitoring.
AboutPage.journeyHeading: From M&E contractor to critical infrastructure partner.
AboutPage.journeyNote: Milestone dates to be confirmed before launch.

AboutPage.apart1Body: One partner across design, procurement, installation, commissioning, and lifetime maintenance — no coordination gaps.
AboutPage.apart2Body: ISO 9001 / 14001 / 45001 quality, environmental, and safety standards, with EDGE and BNSP accreditation.
AboutPage.apart3Body: Trusted by Samsung, Yonex, Santika, RE/MAX, and Mega Bekasi Hypermall, among others across the region.
AboutPage.apart4Body: Headquartered in Jakarta with offices in Singapore and Myanmar — delivered and supported locally.

SolutionsPage.metaDescription: The full mechanical & electrical scope — power & energy, precision cooling, monitoring & security, and integrated M&E contracting for mission-critical facilities.
SolutionsPage.headerDescription: Engineered for environments where downtime is not an option — drawing on a network of specialist capabilities that mission-critical facilities depend on.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Title: The backbone of any critical facility.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Lead: Primary and standby power engineered for continuous operation, with the monitoring and maintenance to keep it reliable across its full life.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Cap1Body: Yuchai diesel & gas gensets; containerized and site-built configurations, sized to facility load.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Cap2Body: Rooftop and ground-mount design and installation, delivered with Powerbrain; 50+ MWp installed.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Cap3Body: Real-time fuel level, consumption, and theft detection, powered by Ramus instrumentation.
SolutionsPage.pillar1Cap4Body: Authorized spare parts and overhaul for IHI / Niigata land and marine engines through Ramoco.
SolutionsPage.pillar2Lead: Cooling typically consumes 40–60% of a facility's electricity. We design and optimize for both performance and energy efficiency.
SolutionsPage.pillar2Cap1Body: Midea, Broad, and Hisense systems for high-density and commercial loads.
SolutionsPage.pillar2Cap2Body: Plant automation, VSD retrofits, pump rewinding; measurable gains (e.g. 1.10 → 0.77 kW/TR on a 3×550 TR plant).
SolutionsPage.pillar2Cap3Body: Zero-CAPEX cooling under a performance-guaranteed energy service agreement, delivered with Powerbrain; backed by an insurance-grade performance bond and IPMVP measurement & verification.
SolutionsPage.pillar3Lead: Critical infrastructure requires constant visibility. We integrate instrumentation and surveillance into a unified operational view.
SolutionsPage.pillar3Cap1Body: Emerson and Endress+Hauser meters for chilled-water and process monitoring, integrated by Ramus.
SolutionsPage.pillar3Cap3Body: Centralized monitoring of power, cooling, and fuel systems.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesBody: Reliability does not end at commissioning. Engine systems are backed by a structured aftersales program delivered with the manufacturer.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint1Rest: trained in Niigata Power Systems, Japan.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint2Rest: combined experience in maintenance, overhaul, and troubleshooting — marine and land-use engines.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint3Rest: from the Customer Support Center for the Indonesian region — troubleshooting, supervision, and overhaul.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint4Rest: to each customer in Indonesia by the principal.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint5Rest: between manufacturer and customer for any clarification or troubleshooting.
SolutionsPage.aftersalesPoint6Rest: — photo details, findings, and manufacturer recommendations.
SolutionsPage.yuchaiBody: The manufacturing backbone behind the gensets we supply and commission — a look inside Yuchai's industrial plant, where the diesel and gas engines that power critical facilities are built.
SolutionsPage.integratedHeading: One partner, not a dozen vendors.
SolutionsPage.integratedBody: SUME's core: a single accountable contractor across the full mechanical and electrical scope — design, procurement, installation, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance. Where most projects coordinate across many specialists, SUME delivers the entire M&E lifecycle under one line of accountability — reducing risk, simplifying delivery, and keeping every critical system aligned.
SolutionsPage.brandsHeading: The specialist names behind every solution.
SolutionsPage.brandsBody: The technologies and capabilities that mission-critical facilities depend on — delivered as one connected network.
SolutionsPage.ctaBody: Tell us about your facility — power, cooling, monitoring, or full M&E scope. Our engineering team will assess and respond.
